messages:
tina: Quick heads-up from onboarding: the HTTP curl example in docs/quickstarts/webhook/README.md still shows an inline API key and parses `usage.tokens` with jq. New SDKs return `usage.total_tokens` and we want env-based creds.

marco: ugh. Which snippet is that? I can grep.

marco: pasted snippet from file: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}' | jq '.usage.tokens'
```

tina: Yep that's the one. Also the README shows a retry example that does `until $(curl ...); do sleep 1; done` which will hammer the endpoint on persistent failures.

marco: good catch. We should update the curl to show `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` and the jq path to `.usage.total_tokens`. For retries show a safe curl wrapper that polls with exponential backoff and a max attempt counter.

infra-bot: Suggestion: add a simple pre-deploy grep job that scans docs/ and examples/ for `sk_live_`, `Authorization: Bearer .*'` with a literal key pattern, and `usage.tokens`. Fail docs deploy if any matches.

marco: I'll open a PR to patch the README and add the CI grep. Also will add a tiny mocked integration test under examples/__tests__/quickstart that validates the snippet output shape so copy/paste fails are surfaced.

docs-bot: PR created by marco: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4189 1 files changed: replace inline key, fix jq path, add retry helper, add docs-lint CI.

tina: Nice. Can you also update the onboarding checklist to include running `scripts/validate-snippets.sh` locally? New hires keep copying examples into prod apps and hitting these regressions.

marco: Will do. Thanks for the report. If anyone sees other stale patterns, grep for `usage.tokens`, `sk_live_`, `until \$\(curl` and toss them in this thread.

infra-bot: Issue filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/3042 1 example files with stale snippets detected.

marco: assigning review to @tina and @alex for the CI change.

tina: happy to review. :thumbsup:
